name: investment.products.history
summary: Native historical versions of one investment product.
purpose: Inspect the history endpoint's returned versions without appending a current product record.

list.description: Read the native history array for one business product code.

parameters.name: product-code
parameters.description: One exact native incrementProductCode, distinct from physical incrementProductId.

identity_description: Native nonblank physical ID of each returned historical version.
limitations: POST form /incrementProductHistoryQuery.json sends exactly tntInstId GUAPW3SG and incrementProductCode. One qualified unpaged native data array is the accepted completion boundary.
Native total remains unknown. Completion covers the returned history array and does not claim proof of invisible backend versions. No current product detail or current-row append.

Preserve complete native fields, nested objects, precise amounts, types and source order. Physical IDs must be nonblank; every row must match the selected product code. Returned nonblank tenant must match GUAPW3SG.
Existing SDK duplicate/conflict and publication policy applies. Live does not publish; complete nonempty refresh and offline replay match. Failed or empty refresh preserves the previous capture.
Bare offline List replays saved scope; product-code supports exact local filtering. No Get, legacy runtime dependency or new Duckdog import.

examples.title: Read one product's native historical versions
